Home.title: Fast-Track Seaport Customs Clearance & European Logistics
Home.body: Globfreight delivers bonded freight forwarding, direct seaport customs declarations, and rapid inland haulage across Antwerp, Rotterdam, and European trade corridors.
Home.portsTitle: Direct Gateway Access Across Primary Seaports
Home.portsSubtitle: Seamless EDI connectivity and dedicated handling across major Northern European port terminals.

pipeline.title: Unified 4-Stage European Delivery Pipeline
pipeline.subtitle: From vessel arrival to final bonded destination with complete transparency and compliance.
pipeline.step1Desc: Pre-arrival manifest processing and direct electronic customs declaration submission.
pipeline.step2Desc: Fast inspection handling, fiscal representation, and zero-demurrage terminal release.
pipeline.step3Desc: NCTS T1/T2 transit documents with dedicated GPS-tracked secure transport.
pipeline.step4Desc: Direct site delivery or bonded storage with real-time proof of delivery.

Home.servicesSubtitle: End-to-end management of your freight, customs compliance, and supply chain needs.

customsDetail.title: AEO-F Certified Customs Declarations
customsDetail.desc: Streamlined import, export, and transit declarations with direct electronic customs interfaces.
customsDetail.point1: Direct EDI connection with Belgian & Dutch customs
customsDetail.point3: Zero demurrage and detention avoidance protocols

transportDetail.title: Express Port & Inland Container Transport
transportDetail.desc: Reliable container haulage connecting main maritime terminals to European industrial hubs.
transportDetail.point1: Dedicated fleet with GPS real-time tracking
transportDetail.point3: Overnight express routes across Benelux & Germany

warehouseDetail.title: Strategic Bonded Storage & Distribution
warehouseDetail.desc: Secure, climate-controlled bonded warehouse facilities located minutes from port terminals.
warehouseDetail.point1: Type II bonded customs warehouse authorization
warehouseDetail.point2: Pick, pack, cross-docking, and palletizing services

fiscalDetail.title: VAT Deferment & Fiscal Representation
fiscalDetail.desc: Optimize cash flow by deferring import VAT at European entry points for foreign entities.
fiscalDetail.point1: General & limited fiscal representation in Belgium & Netherlands
fiscalDetail.point2: Import VAT reverse charge (Article 23 permit support)
fiscalDetail.point3: Complete quarterly EU VAT filings and audit defense

Home.proof3Body: Direct communication with certified declarants without call center delays.
